SELECT max(try_cast(mw_value AS double)) AS peak_mw FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_btm_solar_btmestimatedactual WHERE zone_name = 'CAPITL'
Which states are home to the most federal award recipients?
SELECT state, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_recipient_lookup WHERE state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many applications in the examination file went on to issue as patents?
SELECT count(*) AS granted FROM govblock_patents.patex_application_data_25 WHERE patent_number <> ''
Which operating nuclear reactors have the largest generating capacity?
SELECT plant_name_unit_number AS reactor, try_cast(capacity_mwe AS double) AS mwe FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_dataset_reactors_operating_query_1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the largest number of claims in one published application?
SELECT max(try_cast(pub_clm_ct AS double)) AS most_claims FROM govblock_patents.claims_pgpub_document_stats
Which products did the United States export the most of in 2024?
SELECT comm_desc, sum(try_cast(all_val_yr AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_trade.census_exp_comm WHERE year = '2024' AND month = '12' AND comm_desc IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Reactome reactions have a Rhea counterpart?
SELECT count(DISTINCT id) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.rhea_rhea2reactome
Which bachelor's programs have the highest median earnings two years after graduation?
Scorecard Most Recent Field Of Study

SELECT concat(instnm, ': ', cipdesc) AS program, try_cast(earn_mdn_hi_2yr AS double) AS median_earnings FROM govblock_education.scorecard_most_recent_field_of_study WHERE credlev = '3' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many EPA and state inspections have facilities in Ohio had over the last five years?
SELECT sum(try_cast(fac_inspection_count AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_environment.echo_echo_exporter WHERE fac_state = 'OH'
Which agencies made the most awards in fiscal 2024?

SELECT awarding_toptier_agency_name, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_award_search WHERE cast(fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2024' AND awarding_toptier_agency_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many new papers were posted to arXiv each year from 2015 to 2024?
SELECT substr(first_submitted, 13, 4) AS year, count(*) AS papers FROM govblock_scholarly.arxiv_papers WHERE substr(first_submitted, 13, 4) BETWEEN '2015' AND '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which states had the most units reporting to EPA's Clean Air Markets programs in 2023?
SELECT state, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.campd_facility_attributes WHERE year = 2023 AND state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Do companies pay doctors more in cash or in kind? (2023)

SELECT form_of_payment_or_transfer_of_value, sum(try_cast(total_amount_of_payment_usdollars AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_health.op_general WHERE cast(program_year AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which universities received the most NIH funding in fiscal year 2024?
SELECT org_name, sum(try_cast(total_cost AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE cast(fy AS varchar) = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the oldest GAO report in the library about Medicare?
SELECT title, date FROM govblock_oversight.oversight_reports WHERE source = 'GAO' AND lower(title) LIKE '%medicare%' ORDER BY date LIMIT 5
Which facilities reported the most greenhouse gas emissions in 2022?

SELECT f.facility_name, sum(try_cast(e.co2e_emission AS double)) AS co2e_tons FROM govblock_environment.ghg_facts_subp_ghg_emission AS e JOIN govblock_environment.ghg_dim_facility AS f ON f.facility_id = e.facility_id AND f.year = e.year WHERE e.year = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many babies were born in Manhattan hospitals in 2016?

SELECT count(*) AS discharges FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges WHERE hospital_county = 'Manhattan' AND ccs_diagnosis_description LIKE '%newborn%' AND cast(discharge_year AS varchar) = '2016'
Which counties paid the highest average annual wage in 2023?
Jobs and Wages by County and Industry

SELECT t.area_title, try_cast(q.avg_annual_pay AS double) AS avg_pay FROM govblock_labor.qcew_annual AS q JOIN govblock_labor.qcew_area_titles AS t ON t.area_fips = q.area_fips WHERE q.agglvl_code = '70' AND q.own_code = '0' AND q.year = '2023' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How did the number of phase 3 trials started change from 2010 to 2024?

SELECT substr(start_date, 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS studies FROM govblock_health.ct_studies WHERE phases LIKE '%PHASE3%' AND substr(start_date, 1, 4) IN ('2010', '2024') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10
Where in New York state, city by city, did deadly crashes happen most often in 2022?
SELECT cityname, count(*) AS crashes FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE statename = 'New York' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many materials in the Materials Project are metals?
SELECT count(*) AS materials FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary WHERE cast(is_metal AS varchar) = 'true'
Which utilities serve ZIP code 10001, and at what residential rate?
SELECT utility_name, try_cast(res_rate AS double) AS dollars_per_kwh FROM govblock_solar.urdb_zip_rates WHERE zip = '10001' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How did private-sector employment in Manhattan change from the first quarter of 2019 to the first quarter of 2024?
Jobs and Wages by County and Industry

SELECT year, month3_emplvl AS employed FROM govblock_labor.qcew_quarterly WHERE area_fips = '36061' AND cast(own_code AS varchar) = '5' AND industry_code = '10' AND cast(year AS varchar) IN ('2019', '2024') AND cast(qtr AS varchar) = '1' ORDER BY year
Which hours of July 2023 saw the highest total power plant output in Texas?

SELECT concat(cast(date AS varchar), ' ', cast(hour AS varchar), ':00') AS hour, sum(gross_load_mw) AS total_mw FROM govblock_environment.campd_emissions_hourly WHERE state = 'TX' AND date BETWEEN DATE '2023-07-01' AND DATE '2023-07-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the most U.S. nuclear capacity offline on any single day in 2024?
SELECT max(try_cast(value AS double)) AS megawatts_out FROM govblock_energy.eia_nuc_status_data WHERE series_id = 'NUC_STATUS.OUT.US.D' AND period LIKE '2024%'
Which Treasury maturities are auctioned most often?
SELECT security_term, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_treasury.auctions_query WHERE security_term IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the latest reading in New York's real-time fuel mix?
SELECT max(date_parse(time_stamp, '%m/%d/%Y %H:%i:%s')) AS latest_reading FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_fuel_mix_rtfuelmix
Which utilities operate the most generators?
SELECT utility_name, count(DISTINCT plant_code || '-' || generator_id) AS generators FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_operable GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many injuries have owners of the Tesla Model 3 reported in their complaints?
SELECT sum(try_cast(injured AS integer)) AS injured FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_complaints WHERE maketxt = 'TESLA' AND modeltxt = 'MODEL 3'
What kinds of generator have been retired most often?
Eia860 Generator Y Retired And Canceled

SELECT technology, count(DISTINCT plant_code || '-' || generator_id) AS retired FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_retired_and_canceled WHERE status = 'RE' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
